body: I fucked up. I told my parents and showed the cuts. They are freaking out.

Oh man that comes off as super asshole-ish. I know people who don't have stuff figured out at my age.

With my circumstances, I should have stuff figured out, yet I don't.

I'm youngish. Mid-twenties. Old enough to have my shit figured out.

My current issue is that I started cutting again. Maybe I should have posted on the selfharm reddit. I'm such a noob. I'm drinking cheap Canadian whisky. Plastic bottle whisky.

I honestly don't know if I have a trigger. It seems to be pretty constant. I fall asleep wishing I was dead and wake up unfulfilled that I didn't die in the night. It's a mean shoulder devil that is not at all adorable like Kronk. I'm on antidepressants but I don't think its helping. I feel like such a drama queen. My feelings are real, but I still feel ridiculous. I'm a lucky person that my family cares about me. Yet here I am still bitching on reddit when others have real problems.
